scope: Proposition 5.1 (Interpolated comparison) of the manuscript “The entropy photon-number inequality” (preprints/The-entropy-photon-number-inequality-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 273 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d826f8ebe1859641), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The positive weights Fs(v) = 1 hs f(hsv/2)f(−hs/2) f(hs(v − 1)/2) = bs(v) − (rs + 1 2)v 1 − v (5.3) satisfy (5.1). The quotient at v = 1 is understood continuously.
